snippet.title: Heatstroke Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022090/HeatStroke/
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/b6Gm7ctKcX
Follow Heatstroke on Twitter: https://twitter.com/ItsTheTalia

HeatStroke is a simulation game tasking you to transcribe an unhinged short story while driving down a seemingly endless desert road.
